dimension_docs.temperature_suitability: Equilibrium-temperature match to the 255-288 K range where surface liquid water is plausible with a modest atmosphere.
dimension_docs.habitable_zone_position: Position relative to the Kopparapu et al. (2014) conservative and optimistic habitable zone for the host star's temperature.
dimension_docs.planet_properties: Likelihood of being a rocky world able to retain a temperate atmosphere, from radius and (where known) bulk density.
dimension_docs.stellar_environment: Host-star suitability: main-sequence lifetime, spectral type, activity proxy and age.
dimension_docs.orbital_characteristics: Orbital eccentricity as a proxy for the stability of insolation over an orbit.
dimension_docs.evidence_completeness: Fraction of the model's key inputs that are directly observed rather than modelled or missing.
